description: parseEventText + segmentEventText (chrono-node, forwardDate). `referenceWallclock` is the viewer's local wallclock passed to chrono as a local-components Date (process zone Europe/Berlin). Segment `start`/`end` are UTF-16 code-unit offsets into `text` (equal to char offsets for ASCII; convert for Rust byte offsets). Only the first chrono match is used; outputs mirror chrono-node 2.x behaviour, including its quirks.
